_note: Summaries for orientation only. Amounts and rules change — confirm on the official portal or at your nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra or CSC.

schemes.name: PM-KISAN
schemes.summary: Direct income support to landholding farmer families.
schemes.benefit: ₹6,000 a year, paid as three instalments of ₹2,000 straight into the bank account.
schemes.eligibility: Landholding farmer families. Income-tax payers, pensioners above ₹10,000/month and institutional landholders are excluded.
schemes.how: Register at pmkisan.gov.in or through a Common Service Centre with Aadhaar, land records and a bank passbook. eKYC is compulsory.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.summary: Crop insurance against failure from natural causes.
schemes.benefit: Claim settlement for prevented sowing, standing-crop loss, post-harvest loss and localised calamities.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including sharecroppers and tenants with documented rights.
schemes.how: Enrol through your bank, a CSC or pmfby.gov.in before the cut-off for the season. Premium is 2% of sum insured for kharif, 1.5% for rabi and 5% for commercial or horticultural crops.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.summary: Short-term credit for cultivation at a subsidised rate.
schemes.benefit: Crop loans at 7% interest, dropping to 4% effective if you repay on time. Covers inputs, post-harvest costs and allied activities.
schemes.eligibility: Owner-cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees and sharecroppers; also dairy, poultry and fisheries.
schemes.how: Apply at any bank branch with land documents, identity and address proof. Loans up to ₹1.6 lakh need no collateral.

schemes.name: Soil Health Card
schemes.summary: A laboratory report of your field's nutrient status.
schemes.benefit: Field-specific N-P-K and micronutrient readings with a fertiliser recommendation, so you stop buying what the soil already has.
schemes.eligibility: Every farmer; cards are issued on a cycle for each holding.
schemes.how: Ask your village agriculture officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra to collect a sample, or register at soilhealth.dac.gov.in.

schemes.name: PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana
schemes.summary: Contributory pension for small and marginal farmers.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers aged 18–40 holding up to 2 hectares.
schemes.how: Enrol at a CSC. You contribute ₹55–₹200 a month by age at entry and the government matches it.

schemes.name: Per Drop More Crop (PMKSY micro-irrigation)
schemes.summary: Subsidy on drip and sprinkler systems.
schemes.benefit: 55% subsidy for small and marginal farmers, 45% for others, on the cost of the system.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers with a water source and clear land title.
schemes.how: Apply through the state horticulture or agriculture department portal with a quotation from a registered supplier.

schemes.name: e-NAM
schemes.summary: Online national market for farm produce.
schemes.benefit: Sell to buyers beyond your local mandi, with transparent bidding and payment into your account.
schemes.eligibility: Any farmer who can bring produce to a linked APMC mandi.
schemes.how: Register at enam.gov.in or at the e-NAM counter of a linked mandi with Aadhaar and bank details.

schemes.name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
schemes.summary: Cheap long-term credit for post-harvest infrastructure.
schemes.benefit: 3% interest subvention and a credit guarantee on loans up to ₹2 crore for warehouses, cold storage, grading and packing units.
schemes.eligibility: Individual farmers, FPOs, primary agricultural credit societies, self-help groups and start-ups.
schemes.how: Apply on agriinfra.dac.gov.in and pick a lending bank.
